mapper.select: SELECT adv02_account_id AS account_id, adv02_company_id AS company_id, adv02_manage_cd AS manage_code, adv02_manage_nm AS manage_name, adv02_tr_corp_cd AS tr_corp_code, adv02_tr_corp_nm AS tr_corp_name, TO_DECRYPTS(adv02_account_no) AS account_no_dec, adv02_start_date AS start_date, adv02_close_date AS close_date, adv02_work_date AS work_date, adv02_worker AS worker FROM adv02_account WHERE adv02_company_id = #{p.companyId} AND #{p.orgId} IN ( SELECT adv05_org_code_id FROM adv05_org_auth WHERE adv05_account_id = adv02_account_id AND COALESCE(adv05_auth_yn, 'false') = 'true' ) AND UPPER(CONCAT(adv02_manage_cd, adv02_manage_nm)) LIKE UPPER(#{p.searchText}) ORDER BY adv02_start_date, adv02_manage_cd LIMIT #{p.limit} OFFSET #{p.offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM adv02_account WHERE adv02_company_id = #{p.companyId} AND #{p.orgId} IN ( SELECT adv05_org_code_id FROM adv05_org_auth WHERE adv05_account_id = adv02_account_id AND COALESCE(adv05_auth_yn, 'false') = 'true' ) AND UPPER(CONCAT(adv02_manage_cd, adv02_manage_nm)) LIKE UPPER(#{p.searchText})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO adv05_org_auth (adv05_org_auth_id, adv05_account_id, adv05_org_code_id, adv05_auth_yn) VALUES (#{orgAuthId}, #{accountId}, #{orgCodeId}, #{authYn})
